chunks: "That there was for Banī Hāshim from the Black Stone to the Syrian Corner."

key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الشَّامِيِّ: the Syrian Corner of the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْحَجَرِ الْأَسْوَدِ: the Black Stone in the Ka'bah
key_terms.بَنِي هَاشِمٍ: the clan of Banī Hāshim, the family lineage of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What does the narration say about the area of the Ka'bah associated with Banī Hāshim?
ai.summary: This narration reports a designated portion associated with Banī Hāshim in the area extending from the Black Stone to the Syrian Corner. It reflects a historical detail connected to the Ka'bah and the standing of Banī Hāshim within the context of hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The portion of the Kaaba allocated to Banu Hashim extended from the Black Stone to the Syrian Corner."
